base_member_text: [L43-L50] (LOW/input-error-handling) The root's interactive READ has no IOSTAT, END, or ERR handling, so EOF or malformed input terminates it while other ranks are entering MPI_BCAST.
audit_member_text: [L43-L50] (MED/input-error-handling) The root's READ has no IOSTAT, END or ERR handling, so EOF or malformed input can terminate the root while other ranks wait in MPI_BCAST.

adversarial.rationale: The READ is indeed unhandled and precedes MPI_BCAST; the n<=0 exit test at fpi.f:53 only protects successfully read nonpositive integers. Reduce to LOW robustness of this interactive example: EOF/malformed input can abort the root, but whether peers remain waiting or the launcher tears down the job is runtime-dependent, not a demonstrated persistent MPI deadlock.
